papers.s2: A fair, fairly easy paper with 20% from lessons 1-5. Listening and vocabulary are clean, but only four grammar items (25-28) test what 乐读 actually teaches (radicals, 意符/声符); there is nothing on strokes or stroke order. The reading texts are so full of untaught characters that they read like a general HSK paper. All four order items accept a second word order, and three reading items give away answers elsewhere.
papers.mid2: Coverage of lessons 6-10 is even, and the grammar section is the best part: real radical and component knowledge (讠, 日, 亡, 乍, stroke count of 肉). But the paper leaks a lot. Seven of the eight hand items show their word somewhere else in the paper, three pairs of reply questions share one option set, and the 'which character do X, Y, Z share' items copy the answer from the stem. Writing ends up far too easy and reading partly answerable by elimination.
papers.final: It covers lessons 1-10 very evenly (one item per lesson per kind) and feels like a real exam in shape. Too much is recycled, though: the same word is asked twice across parts (上午, 长城, 上课), texts reappear as order answers or reply options, and half of the hand items can be copied from the paper. Several 'character knowledge' blanks put the answer in the stem (月亮, 树木, 电话电脑). Five of the ten order items accept a second order, so writing is both leaky and unfair.

rules: Before a paper is final, collect every visible string (stems, options, texts, tiles) and reject any hand, fill, blank or order item whose answer word or sentence appears in that set. This one check removes most leaks.
Test each word at most once per paper across hear, meaning, pick, fill and hand, and use each sentence (heard or shown) at most once, including as a reply option, text line or order answer.
Reply items must draw distractors so that no two reply items share an option, and no option sentence is heard or shown elsewhere in the paper.

Order items need a list of accepted answers: allow time words and topics first, either order of nouns joined by 和 and of adjectives in 又…又…, and both 住在哪儿 and 在哪儿住. Exclude sentences of two clauses, or include the comma.
In judge items the claim must keep the text's person: if the text says 我, the claim says 我 (or names the person).
Don't include text items whose English question translates a word tested by a meaning or pick item in the same paper (beach, bicycle, hobby, all day).
Character-knowledge blanks must not contain their answer in the stem (月亮 → 月, 树木 → 木, '电话、电脑…都有“___”', 医院 → 医) and must not share a radical or component with another item in the paper.
Fill and blank distractors must be the same part of speech as the answer but fail in the frame; flag stems shorter than about five characters (e.g. '___在酒店') as under-constrained.
